name_vi: Băng ghế dài có tựa lưng
description_en: A long woven bench with a flat seat, separate full-width back panel and open ends; the front shows three open spaces below the seat, the side reveals upright back posts and seat overhang, and the rear has repeated vertical back uprights and a long stretcher. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A long woven bench with a flat seat, separate full-width back panel and open ends; the front shows three open spaces below the seat, the side reveals upright back posts and seat overhang, and the rear has repeated vertical back uprights and a long stretcher. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.. Style Zen: calm minimal ornament and simple proportions. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
